name: ARC-400A Industrial MMA Welder 250A

images.alt: GOWELLDE ARC-400A industrial MMA welding machine

summary: 250A industrial stick welder with dual power options up to three-phase.
description: The ARC-400A is the industrial tier of the 400 class: 250A output, an 8×470µF capacitor bank and a T80 transformer for demanding production environments. Multiple input options (220V, 380V or 3-phase 380V) let one SKU serve different site power conditions.
features: Industrial housing with reinforced front panel
